sequence.purpose: Reconcile QA-proven archive RPC bodies, 18 authenticated private invoker grants, co-owner metadata trigger and least-privilege helper ACLs. Explicitly revokes authenticated TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER on public.condominium_fund_availability to close the only remaining effective relation-ACL difference. Revokes anon/PUBLIC execution on both transfer-closure helpers while preserving authenticated/service_role execution, and removes anon CRUD defaults for future public tables.
sequence.postcondition: All 18 guarded private implementations are callable by authenticated through their SECURITY INVOKER wrappers; trigger helper direct EXECUTE is revoked; archive/restore bodies and incoming co-owner metadata trigger match QA; private is_workspace_staff is not client-executable. Effective authenticated TRUNCATE, REFERENCES and TRIGGER on public.condominium_fund_availability are false. Transfer-closure helpers are not executable by anon; authenticated retains explicit execution. postgres-owned public table defaults grant no CRUD to anon.

sequence.purpose: Align default privileges for future public tables while preserving provider-owned supabase_admin defaults.
sequence.postcondition: Authenticated receives CRUD on future public tables; service_role receives CRUD plus structural privileges; anon receives none; no application role receives MAINTAIN.

sequence.purpose: Reassert least-privilege EXECUTE ACLs for public trigger functions without changing their ownership or provider execution path.
sequence.postcondition: PUBLIC, anon and authenticated cannot directly execute the two trigger functions; service_role retains its existing execution privilege; ownership remains postgres.

sequence.purpose: Remove PUBLIC and application-role default EXECUTE/sequence privileges for future public functions and sequences.
sequence.postcondition: No global or public-schema default function/sequence ACL entries remain for PUBLIC, anon, authenticated or service_role; provider supabase_admin defaults are unchanged.

sequence.purpose: Repair portal registration upsert; enforce exact condominium binding for resident self-registration and administrator approval, serialize member-account linking with row locks, preserve existing member links and staff roles, require verified matching account/member email, and fail closed on same-workspace same-name condominium ambiguity for both automatic and manual registration paths.
sequence.postcondition: Both authenticated registration entry points use the centralized helper; a supplied condominium name must match the selected member's active condominium; wrong-condominium auto/manual approval fails without linking or portal-access side effects; member rows are locked before user_id checks/updates; self-registration is rejected when the selected name identifies multiple active condominiums in the same workspace; unassigned approval is rejected when the verified request email matches multiple active members across same-named condominiums in the selected workspace; duplicate legacy-id/email matches and archived condominiums fail closed; helper is not directly executable by anon/authenticated/service_role. The ambiguity guard also uses the matched member's condominium name when the resident omits the optional name, so omission cannot bypass the duplicate-name block.
